profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at Raytheon Technologies
profile.summary:
C++, OOP and multi-threaded programming experienced on OEM Embedded Navigation Systems, I have also explored iOS, Android and Linux mobile platforms, changing hats to Java or Qt half of the time.  The latest territory is Machine Learning and Deep-learning, with a forever-growing and attractive Python :)

I take work seriously.  I do enjoy team work and challenging problems (if time allows ... ).  A solid implementation or an elegant solution would be one of those things that give me strength on staying-late workdays.  On the other hand, bouncing ideas around seems to be the best way to generate new ones and reinforce old ones.
